title.narrative: ROAP/CAM03/Increasing climate resilience through small-scale infrastructure investments and enhancing adaptive capacity of vulnerable communities in Kampot and Koh Kong Provinces in Cambodia

description.narrative:
The proposed project “Increasing climate resilience through small-scale infrastructure investments and enhancing adaptive capacity of vulnerable communities in Kampot and Koh Kong Provinces in Cambodia” has the overall objective to support climate resilient and adaptive development and increase capacity for climate variability/change adaptation of target communities living in Kampot and Koh Kong Provinces. This will be achieved through three interconnected components with related outcomes and outputs:
Component 1: Enhanced resilience of communities and built infrastructure, resulting in increased capacity to withstand extreme weather events and adapt to ongoing climate variability and change (US$ 5,767,859).
Component 2: Enhanced resilient capacity of vulnerable communities through improved conditions of coastal ecosystems and income diversification (US$ 1,584,613).
Component 3: Enhanced effectiveness of climate adaptation planning and implementation, leading to increased coping capacity for addressing climate variability and reducing risks, as well as facilitating the sustained scaling-up of transformative adaptation interventions at the local level (US$ 988,543).
